brand.name: Figma
brand.elevatorPitch: Go from WIP to ship, together, on one creative canvas. Bring your teammates, AI agents, design context, and code into the same workspace to build better products.
brand.boilerplate: About Figma: Figma is a design platform for teams who build products together. Its tools help teams brainstorm, design, and build products from start to finish, with shared libraries, prototyping, developer tools, and AI capabilities. Serving solo founders through enterprise organizations, Figma connects workflows across teams and time zones. Based on March 2025 data, 95% of the Fortune 500 uses Figma.
brand.description: Figma is the canvas where design, code, and AI come together. From first idea to shipped product — go from concept to production with your whole team, in one place.

voice.summary: Figma pairs creative ambition with practical building language. Its voice is collaborative, action-led, and fluent in design and development, with occasional maker shorthand and playful warmth.

traits.name: Together by default
traits.description: Frames creativity and product development as shared work, not individual heroics.
traits.do: Describe how teammates contribute, align, and build in the same space.
traits.dont: Position a lone genius or individual ownership as the source of great products.

evidence.quote: Made so your whole team can go from WIP to ship, together.
Our vision is to make design accessible to all because we know that nothing great is made alone.

traits.name: Expressive and exact
traits.description: Balances imaginative possibility with precision, craft, and intentional execution.
traits.do: Pair creative outcomes with concrete controls, context, or tools that make them achievable.
traits.dont: Celebrate limitless creativity without explaining how people can refine or build it.

evidence.quote: We build for builders and try to make complex things feel simple.

traits.name: Momentum with intention
traits.description: Promises speed while insisting on alignment, consistency, and the right outcome.
traits.do: Use active verbs and connect faster work to better decisions or faithful delivery.
traits.dont: Treat speed as a reason to skip craft, context, or feedback.

evidence.quote: Move fast in the right direction on an AI-native canvas.
Start with design context. Build with consistency.

traits.name: Maker-minded warmth
traits.description: Uses insider language and playful phrasing to make ambitious technical work feel human.
traits.do: Use familiar maker terms sparingly and welcome exploration alongside practical work.
traits.dont: Use stiff corporate abstractions or force jokes into feature and pricing explanations.

evidence.quote: We’re multiplayer people who love the weird, wonderful magic that happens when people connect.

styleRules: Use sentence case for headings, preserving product names and acronyms.
Lead headings and CTAs with active verbs such as Build, Create, Explore, and Choose.
Keep headlines short; use fuller explanatory sentences around 20 words when describing workflows or capabilities.
Address the reader as you or your in product copy; use we and our for company values and culture.
Use em dashes to connect an outcome or aside, and paired short sentences for emphasis; keep exclamation marks and rhetorical questions rare.
Retain useful design and developer terminology, but connect it to an action or outcome; present pricing and limits with numerals and clear units.
